title: X Japan: Virtual Shock 001
overview:
X Japan: Virtual Shock 001 is a music entertainment disc built around the Japanese rock band X Japan - Yoshiki, Toshi, Hide, Pata and Heath. Supervised by the band members themselves, it is packed with live footage from the band's two 1994 nights at the Tokyo Dome and includes three of their then-latest songs.

Go backstage and meet the band as they really are, with many of X Japan's real staff appearing too. Along the way you take photos of the members, and the shots you capture are used to put together your own original video.

- Full-screen live concert scenes
- Backstage access with the band and its crew
- Create your own original video
